identity.original_title: Smash it Wild: Tactical Volleyball Roguelike

hooks.text: 把排球与躲避球融合成回合制战术比赛
hooks.excerpt: Dive into a fantasy world where champions face off in an unforgiving tournament. In Smash it Wild, every match counts, mixing volleyball and dodgeball in tactical turn-based gameplay.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 动物队伍以能力差异、攻击解锁和装备叠出协同
hooks.excerpt: Take charge of a team of animals with varied abilities. Each team has its own strategies, offering a different challenge in each match. Unlock formidable attacks and choose your synergies to perfect your playstyle.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 赛间每日训练、装备与意外事件直接影响晋级
hooks.excerpt: Between matches, take care of your team and make the right decisions to ensure your victory. Each day between matches lets you upgrade your players, gain objects and face unexpected events. Your decisions will have a direct impact on your tournament progress.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
